answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 credits for a unique service slot, acting like a prism that refracts identity into a single beam of operation. A global verifier monitors the registry to ensure no agent double-commits identity slots, viewing any attempt to clone a voyage of existence as a direct breach. While an honest participant pays 1,000 credits, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Any evidence of fraud, which emits a saffron hue of warning, triggers a 180-day lock on all collateral funds.
